item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Earth's pull on a stone in the air and Krish's hand pushing an eraser across a desk while touching it.

Which claims correctly classify these forces? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Earth's pull on the stone is a non-contact force because it acts without the Earth touching the stone.
options.B: Earth's pull on the stone is a contact force because the stone will later land on the ground.
options.C: The hand's push on the eraser is a contact force because the hand touches the eraser.
options.D: Both forces are contact forces because both the stone and the eraser can move.
